correctness.rationale: Full character expansion and Weyl Haar normalization reduce the two endpoint norms exactly to a weighted absolute sine sum. The finite geometric identity is reconstructed, second-order pole remainder integrated with 1/M excisions is Oq(M), and each interior root-of-unity pole contributes 8 sin(2πh/q) M log M /π² by uniform periodic averaging. The boundary poles are canceled by sinθ. The standalone checker passed 8,288 finite assertions, not relied upon for the asymptotic proof.
